info.brief: asobi sign-in over REST: accounts, OAuth, guest devices, linked providers and the token
info.description:
asobi sign-in over REST: accounts, OAuth, guest devices, linked providers and the token
pair. A project reaches it as `client.auth`.

elements.name: register
elements.brief: Creates an account and signs it in. On success it stores the returned tokens with
elements.description:
Creates an account and signs it in. On success it stores the returned tokens with
`client.set_tokens` and sets `client.player_id`.

parameters.name: display_name
parameters.doc: The name other players see. Defaults to `username`.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Receives the token pair and `player_id`, or the error.

elements.name: login
elements.brief: Signs an account in. On success it stores the returned tokens with `client.set_tokens`
elements.description:
Signs an account in. On success it stores the returned tokens with `client.set_tokens`
and sets `client.player_id`.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Receives the token pair and `player_id`, or the error.

elements.name: oauth
elements.brief: Signs in with a token from an OAuth provider. On success it stores the returned tokens
elements.description:
Signs in with a token from an OAuth provider. On success it stores the returned tokens
with `client.set_tokens` and sets `client.player_id`.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Receives the token pair and `player_id`, or the error.

elements.name: guest
elements.brief: Signs a guest in with a device credential pair. On success it stores the returned tokens
elements.description:
Signs a guest in with a device credential pair. On success it stores the returned tokens
with `client.set_tokens` and sets `client.player_id`.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Receives the token pair and `player_id`, or the error.

elements.name: guest_device
elements.brief: Loads the saved device credential pair, or generates and saves one, and signs a guest in
elements.description:
Loads the saved device credential pair, or generates and saves one, and signs a guest in
with it through `guest`.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Receives the token pair and `player_id`, or the error.

elements.name: guest_device
elements.brief: Loads the saved device credential pair, or generates and saves one, and signs a guest in
elements.description:
Loads the saved device credential pair, or generates and saves one, and signs a guest in
with it through `guest`.

parameters.name: opts
parameters.doc:
Where the pair is saved and how it is generated, passed to
`asobi.device.load_or_create`.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Receives the token pair and `player_id`, or the error.

elements.name: upgrade_guest
elements.brief: Turns the signed-in guest into an account with a username and password. On success it
elements.description:
Turns the signed-in guest into an account with a username and password. On success it
stores the returned tokens with `client.set_tokens` and sets `client.player_id`.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Receives the token pair and `player_id`, or the error.

elements.name: link_provider
elements.brief: Links an OAuth provider to the signed-in account.
elements.description: Links an OAuth provider to the signed-in account.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Receives the server's answer, or the error.

elements.name: unlink_provider
elements.brief: Unlinks an OAuth provider from the signed-in account.
elements.description: Unlinks an OAuth provider from the signed-in account.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Receives the server's answer, or the error.

elements.name: refresh
elements.brief: Exchanges the refresh token for a new token pair, which it stores with
elements.description:
Exchanges the refresh token for a new token pair, which it stores with
`client.set_tokens`. The server accepts each refresh token once. An open realtime
connection re-authenticates with the new access token. `asobi.http` calls it on a 401.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Receives the new token pair, or the error.

elements.name: logout
elements.brief: Signs out, then forgets both tokens and `client.player_id` whether or not the server
elements.description:
Signs out, then forgets both tokens and `client.player_id` whether or not the server
answered with an error.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Receives the server's answer, or the error.
